prompts.prompt: Where is the customer experience leaking across channels?
prompts.answer: Last 7 days: 428,195 contacts; 19,647 open more than 48 hours. The highest share open too long is Branch (7%). Public voice is shown separately.

prompts.prompt: How much comes back after Cora, as a call or a complaint?
prompts.answer: Last 7 days: Cora took 131,060 contacts and resolved 119,586; 8,693 are still open. Calls: 191,337. Since 1 August, 158,002 of 1,599,037 Cora conversations resolved by 6 Nov (10%) came back as a call or a complaint within 7 days. Internal, illustrative.

prompts.prompt: How many complaints could go to the Financial Ombudsman Service?
prompts.answer: As of 13 Nov, 07:45: 408 complaints are within 10 days of the final-response deadline, 713 are past it with no final response, 3,179 are unhappy with the final response, and 1,210 have been referred. Rules: 8 weeks; payment services 15 business days (35 in exceptional cases). Eligibility and risk only; LisN does not predict who will refer.

prompts.prompt: Which journey is leaking most customers this week?
prompts.answer: Everyday banking: 31 of the 79 switching-intent contacts in the journey-stages table (sample of 32,000 contacts since 1 August) followed a contact at that stage. Next: Switch or close (21) and Service requests (10). One week of the sample is too thin to rank stages. Internal, illustrative.

prompts.prompt: What is the Consumer Duty evidence for financially vulnerable customers?
prompts.answer: Last 7 days: 97,712 contacts from customers flagged financially vulnerable; 9,812 open, 270 with no reply after 48 hours. Consumer Duty outcomes: Products and services · price and value · consumer understanding · consumer support.
